description: Dual-orientation & responsive layout: dynamic camera framing with reserved-space support, live state-preserving re-frame on resize/rotation (debounced, instant snap), landscape right-side palette rail reusing the existing drag contract, auto-fit level-select grid, safe-area aware chrome, and a full 16x4 e2e viewport matrix against the production build (390x844, 844x390, 768x1024, 1024x768).
